pages.text: Bubba's Bees adds 40 bees that make the blocks of the world: stone and dirt, every biome's plants and logs, Nether and End blocks, and every ore.$(br2)Each bee brings home its own honeycomb, and the combs craft into blocks.

$(li)Craft an $(l:tools/hives)Advanced Beehive$(/l).$(li)Craft a $(l:basics/stars)Lesser Bubba Star$(/l).$(li)Craft a $(l:basics/gems)conversion gem$(/l) and use it on a vanilla bee.$(li)Give the bee its flowers.$(li)$(l:basics/harvest)Harvest$(/l) the combs and craft them.
